meta_description: Connolly Plumbing and Heating in Sunderland. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, and heating installation. Fast response, 24/7 callouts available.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Sunderland? We respond within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing and Heating Services Across Sunderland
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full system installations, we handle every plumbing and heating challenge.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to resolve most issues same day, whatever the hour.

services.title: Boiler Repair and Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler checks keep your heating reliable and your warranty valid. We diagnose faults quickly and repair or replace with minimal downtime.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom suites, from new pipework to tiling and decoration. We manage the whole job so you get a finished space, not a half-done site.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New heating systems tailored to your home size and budget. We handle design, pipework, boiler fitting, and commissioning with a 10-year parts guarantee.

services.title: Radiator Repairs and Replacement
services.desc: Cold radiators, noise, and leaks are our bread and butter. We bleed, repair, or fit new radiators without disrupting your home.

services.title: Unblocking and Drain Cleaning
services.desc: Blocked sinks, toilets, and drains cleared using proven techniques. We locate the problem, clear it, and advise on preventing future blockages.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was tired of cowboys overcharging my neighbours.
about_para_1: Connolly Plumbing and Heating was founded over a decade ago on a simple promise: honest pricing, fast response, and no hidden fees. We've grown from a one-man operation to a team of Gas Safe Registered engineers covering all of Sunderland and the surrounding areas. Every member of our team carries the same commitment to doing the job right first time.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on showing up when we say we will, diagnosing problems clearly, and giving you the true cost upfront. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and personal referrals — that's what happens when you treat people fairly and leave their homes cleaner than you found them.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at half eleven on a Sunday night. Rang Connolly and they came out within 45 minutes. Paul was brilliant—found the problem, sorted it, and explained what happened without all the jargon. No messing about with the bill either. Absolute legend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in just before Christmas. Rang around and got quoted a fortune for a replacement. Called Connolly as a last resort and they had a new one fitted in two days with a 10-year guarantee. Heating's been perfect since and the price was fair. Would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Janet K.

reviews.text: Redid our entire bathroom including new pipes, radiator, and suite. Work was tidy, team turned up on time every day, and they cleaned up properly when finished. Not the cheapest but you get what you pay for. Very happy with the result.
reviews.author: David C.
